quarterly_data.quarter: ChipMOS press release: ChipMOS REPORTS RECORD HIGH QUARTERLY REVENUE; 33.8% YoY (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ChipMOS third quarter 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$8,400.8 million (US$263.8 million), a record high, up 13.8% from the second quarter of 2026 (NT$7,383.1 million) and up 36.7% from the third quarter of 2025 (NT$6,143.7 million). The company said revenue growth was driven by sustained AI-related demand outpacing available memory supply; while it continues to invest in footprint expansion, new capacity is being deployed to meet existing customer forecasts and long-term supply agreements, as structural supply constraints persist and demand broadens across most of its memory and storage end markets.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue NT$8,400.8 million (US$263.8 million), record high; +13.8% QoQ; +36.7% YoY
